form.label: Client → Hypervisor → App
form.description: Three columns — the user's Linux desktop, the Proxmox hypervisor, and the web-app — each with its own status, metrics, and detail.

search.query: | makeresults | appendcols [ search index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c latest(_time) as lt | eval client=if(c>0 AND (now()-lt)<900,1,0) | fields client ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c, count(eval(status="error" OR status="not_configured")) as e | eval hv=if(c>e,1,0) | fields hv ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=webapp-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval webct=if(c>0,1,0) | fields webct ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=db-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval dbct=if(c>0,1,0) | fields dbct ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(reachable) as r | eval app=if(r=1,1,0) | fields app ] | eval client=coalesce(client,0), hv=coalesce(hv,0), webct=coalesce(webct,0), dbct=coalesce(dbct,0), app=coalesce(app,0) | eval Health=if(client=1 AND hv=1 AND webct=1 AND dbct=1 AND app=1,"● AVAILABLE","● UNAVAILABLE") | eval range=if(Health=="● AVAILABLE","low","severe") | table Health range

index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c latest(_time) as lt | eval Status=if((c>0 AND (now()-lt)<900),"ONLINE","OFFLINE") | table Status
index=london_metrics sourcetype=linux:metrics host=desktop-* | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" avg(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %"

index=london_linux sourcetype=linux:sessions host=desktop-* event=session status=logged_in | stats latest(_time) as last, latest(from) as from, latest(login_time) as login_time by user tty | eval last=strftime(last,"%F %T") | table user tty from login_time last | sort user

index=london_linux sourcetype=linux:ps host=desktop-* event=process | stats latest(pcpu) as "CPU %", latest(pmem) as "Mem %", latest(user) as user, latest(_time) as t by comm pid | where t >= relative_time(now(),"-3m") | sort - "CPU %" | head 10 | table comm pid user "CPU %" "Mem %"

index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c, count(eval(status=="error" OR status=="not_configured")) as errs | eval Status=if(c>errs,"REACHABLE","NOT REACHABLE") | table Status
index=berlin_metrics sourcetype=proxmox:metrics otype=node | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_pct) as "CPU %" avg(mem_used_pct) as "Mem %"

index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" (type=lxc OR type=qemu) | stats latest(status) as Status latest(type) as Type latest(vmid) as VMID by name | rename name as Name | table VMID Type Name Status | sort VMID

table.title: Status — available only if BOTH containers run and the app+DB are reachable

search.query: | makeresults | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=webapp-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval web=if(c>0,"running","down") | fields web ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_proxmox sourcetype=proxmox:api endpoint="cluster/resources" name=db-berlin status=running earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count as c | eval db=if(c>0,"running","down") | fields db ] | appendcols [ search index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe earliest=-15m latest=now | stats latest(reachable) as r | eval app=if(r=1,"yes","no") | fields app ] | eval web=coalesce(web,"down"), db=coalesce(db,"down"), app=coalesce(app,"no") | eval Status=if(web="running" AND db="running" AND app="yes","AVAILABLE","NOT AVAILABLE") | rename web as "Web container", db as "DB container", app as "App+DB reachable" | table Status "Web container" "DB container" "App+DB reachable"
index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | timechart span=1m latest(reachable) as reachable avg(latency_ms) as "latency (ms)"
index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:probe | head 1 | eval checked=strftime(_time,"%F %T"), state=if(reachable=1,"AVAILABLE","NOT AVAILABLE") | table checked state target http_status latency_ms

index=berlin_web sourcetype=webapp:access action=db_write | sort - _time | head 10 | eval t=strftime(_time,"%F %T"), result=if(db_ok=="true" OR db_ok==1,"ok","FAILED") | table t src_ip name note result db_rows

html.p: A user on the Linux desktop reaches the web-app (webapp-berlin), which writes to the PostgreSQL container (db-berlin) — both LXC on the Proxmox hypervisor. Service Health up top is AVAILABLE only when the client is online, the hypervisor is reachable, BOTH containers run, and the app+DB are reachable. Only gary (global) sees all of it; Leo sees the client, Ben the Berlin side.
